kyc.title: Aadhaar KYC
kyc.statusVerifiedBody: Your Aadhaar has been verified. Nothing more to do here.
kyc.statusPendingBody: Verify your Aadhaar through DigiLocker to start accepting rides.
kyc.confirmingBody: Checking your verification with our servers. This takes a few seconds.
kyc.step1: Tap Verify with Aadhaar to open DigiLocker.
kyc.step2: Give consent, then enter your Aadhaar number and the OTP sent to your linked mobile.
kyc.step3: Come back to the app — we confirm the result automatically.
kyc.consentNote: You are handed over to DigiLocker, the Government of India service. We never see your Aadhaar number or OTP.
kyc.verifiedNote: Your Aadhaar details are stored securely and are never shown in the app.
kyc.stillProcessing: Verification is still processing. This can take a moment — try again shortly, and contact support if it keeps failing.
kyc.statusFailedBody: We couldn't verify your Aadhaar. You can start the verification again.
kyc.startFailed: Verification is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
kyc.webviewFailed: Couldn't load the verification page. Please try again.
kyc.statusFailed: Couldn't check your verification status. Pull down to refresh.
kyc.processingBody: Hang on while we confirm your Aadhaar verification. This takes a few seconds.
